Same pinned wolf0.2.35/lupin0.1.56/std2386522e on macOS26.6.2 arm64, image20261013.0424.1, Apple clang21.0.0.

The extra install-program flags and bu35 shared-code changes do not move these verdicts. Historical green versus current image/build drift is not further localized.
Do not call this a proven GNU implementation bug. The inherited platform qualification needs a separate repair lane.
Only the exact listed failing rows get a loud Darwin skip; all other rows remain live. No expected outputs or inherited implementations changed.
